name: @baibai/cli
description: Trade on baibai from the command line.

scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --target node --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' --outfile dist/baibai.mjs && chmod +x dist/baibai.mjs
scripts.check: biome check . && tsc --project tsconfig.json --pretty false --noEmit && bun test
